eventRemarks: Fish caught by a local ranger and bought by Jose for dinner. Caught in a stream off of Lake Cochrane. Rainbow trout are introduced to this area and are a tourism draw, despite being harmful to the native ecology. The fish looks large and healthy by my standards, but the person who caught it remarked that it was relatively small. What is the fish community composition of this lake? The surrounding terrestrial plant life has a dense understory with many shrubs and grasses with interspersed tall standing trees that I observe to be mostly coihue common. The beach is made up of small rocks that continue into the water, which is very clear and clean (we have been drinking this lake water in our tea!).
